reason_network: Couldn't reach the service. Check your connection and try again.
reason_timeout: The service took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
reason_busy: The service is busy right now. Wait a few seconds and try again.
reason_bad_response: The service sent an answer the app couldn't read. Try again later.
reason_local: Something went wrong on this computer. Restart the app and try again.
reason_answered_error: The service answered with an error. Try again later.
reason_not_found: The service couldn't find it. It may have been removed.
reason_service_down: The service is down or having trouble right now. Nothing is wrong on your end — try again later.
reason_busy_wait: The service is busy right now. Try again in about {seconds} s.
